name: MECH-MIND ROBOT
summary: Mech-Mind Robotics Technologies Co., Ltd. develops and provides core technologies and products for robotics, including 3D vision systems, dexterous robotic hands, and large language models for robotic perception, understanding, and decision-making in Chinese Mainland, Japan, South Korea, the United States, Canada and Europe. The company offers the mech-eye series of industrial and 3D cameras for high-precision, high-speed acquisition of three-dimensional information, and the mech-hand dexterous robotic hand for flexible object manipulation in complex tasks.
